value.rationale: A complete motivated classification of a natural family of dense bipartite graphs with identical (2n,n(n-2)) size/degree data. Cycle decomposition causes three-periodic sphere dimension and powers-of-two multiplicity; n=9 partitions (9),(3,6),(3,3,3) yield 4,8,16 high-dimensional generators, all with 46 degree-two spheres. The mechanism is structural, not a single computed table or routine constant improvement.
